**What this does, and why**

**Checklist** (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`)
- [ ] `make fmt check` passes locally
- [ ] New behaviour has table tests; a bug fix has a regression test
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry, if this is user-visible
- [ ] A decision that's hard to undo has an ADR in `docs/adr/`
- [ ] Code derived from rrcd carries a header naming the file it ports
